## 🛰️ Core Scientific Methodology

FireSync resolves Earth Observation inconsistencies between NASA's MODIS (Aqua/Terra) and VIIRS (Suomi-NPP/NOAA-20) instruments:

1. **Spatio-Temporal Coincidence Window:**
   * Spatial buffer: $\text{distance} \le 500\,\text{m}$
   * Temporal buffer: $|\Delta t| \le 30\,\text{minutes}$
2. **Confidence-Weighted FRP Fusion:**
   $$\text{FRP}_{\text{fused}} = \frac{w_m \cdot \text{FRP}_m + w_v \cdot \text{FRP}_v}{w_m + w_v}$$
   Where VIIRS categorical confidences are mapped to $[0.3, 0.7, 1.0]$ and MODIS confidence is normalized from percentage.
3. **Planar Distance Metric:**
   Automatic reprojection via GeoPandas to local UTM / EPSG:3857 for distortion-free distance measurements.

## ⚙️ Quick Start
```powershell
# 1. Clone repository
git clone https://github.com/fazeli1977-dot/FireSync-MODIS-VIIRS.git
cd FireSync-MODIS-VIIRS

# 2. Install dependencies
pip install -r requirements.txt

# 3. Run unit tests
python -m pytest tests/ -v

# 4. Launch interactive dashboard
streamlit run app.py
